Name: Peninnah
Role: Wife of Elkanah; Rival of Hannah
Summary: Peninnah was Elkanah's other wife. She had children and provoked Hannah bitterly because Hannah had none, year after year at Shiloh.
KeyStory: Peninnah's provoking drove Hannah to pray the prayer that gave Israel Samuel.
LifeLesson: Words used to wound can become the pressure that drives someone to God — and a warning about how we use our own.
